entries.worked: Qwen is a first-class Pi provider via createProvider + openAICompletionsApi. Keys: QWEN_API_KEY or DASHSCOPE_API_KEY. Base URL: QWEN_BASE_URL or DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL, default DashScope intl compatible-mode. Same BYO-key path as OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Do not remove OpenRouter or qwen-token-plan.

Defaults: PI_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=qwen, PI_DEFAULT_MODEL=qwen-plus. SPARK_GX10_BASE_URL set → provider spark-gx10 / deepseek-v4-flash. Explicit PI_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=openrouter keeps deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731.
User-facing name MeshVault. Keep @rakazo/* workspace names. Electron productName MeshVault, appId ai.meshvault.desktop. Expo name/slug/scheme meshvault; API still trusts rakazo:// and meshvault://.
entries.failed: Renaming npm packages without a lockfile rewrite breaks pnpm. Do not rename @rakazo/*.

entries.worked: Rituals live in AGENTS.md. No CLAUDE.md in this repo. Structured context is .agents/context.json (append JSON records). PLAN.md is plan→decompose→validate→repeat. Failed impl → revise plan, retry; no LLM review loop. Do not add mulch/seeds.

Bot provider/model pairs persist in Prisma and flow through create/update/get. Executor precedence is resumed run, bot, scoped workspace default, deployment default, scripted fixture. Credential provider upsert and default switching are transactional and workspace scoped; PostgreSQL unique indexes enforce one provider row and one default. Exact provider/model and exact env-key routing passed 175 tests plus 2 Chromium journeys with an explicit OrbStack socket and test-only ENCRYPTION_KEY.
entries.failed: Testcontainers did not discover the active OrbStack context without DOCKER_HOST. The verify harness also omits ENCRYPTION_KEY; supplying a test-only value completed the gate.

entries.worked: Executor preflight now rejects incomplete or unknown exact provider/model pairs and fails the run when neither a scoped credential nor the selected Pi provider's own ambient auth resolves. A configured Mesh Bot gateway explicitly supports its documented keyless local mode. Credential rotation without modelId preserves the existing provider model and default state; a new provider requires an explicit model. Full verification applied four migrations, passed 181 tests, and passed two Chromium journeys.

Takeover binds the exact waiting run without enqueueing. Release CAS-verifies scoped owner control and the bound waiting run, atomically clears control and queues it, then uses one deterministic wakeup job. The checkpoint gives Pi explicit post-handoff context. Concurrent release journey, 183 tests, and two Chromium journeys passed.
entries.failed: Testcontainers needed the verified OrbStack DOCKER_HOST. The first browser rerun found two visible Release buttons; scoping to the full-screen button fixed the test without changing product behavior.
